info.title: Cloud Foundry V3 API, for STACKIT Cloud Foundry
info.description: Trimmed by a script from the OpenAPI document Cloud Foundry publishes at v3-apidocs.cloudfoundry.org/openapi/latest/openapi.yaml (source: cloudfoundry/cloud_controller_ng docs/openapi, at b8cc317e, read 2026-11-01; it calls itself experimental) to the operations the STACKIT provider needs. Examples, `links`, `included` and the 401/5xx responses every operation shares are dropped, and long descriptions cut to their first line. Changes from the source, all to describe the wire: the API root declares the `login` link (the source omits it; v3-apidocs.cloudfoundry.org, "Global API Root"); `Relationships` is a map of to-one relationships (the source leaves it an empty object); filters are plain strings, because the API takes them comma-delimited; UAA's `POST /oauth/token`, which isn't part of this API, is added from docs.cloudfoundry.org/api/uaa "Password Grant". `servers` holds STACKIT's eu01 platform for reference: each platform's URL is part of `CloudFoundryCredentials`.

service_instance.description: The service instance to be bound

app.description: The app to be bound. Required when type is app

relationships.description: Relationships for the service credential binding

parameters.description: A JSON object that is passed to the service broker
